text:
The price of one point.

And here is what that costs. Through the air means through the room. A cord from the rim to the ring under the cap passes, halfway to the wall, only 1.2 metres above a floor laid at the rim. Fine while it is a frame hanging in the trees. In a home, those cords are lowered away once the dome is set where it will stay, or it is hung by its rim instead.
